entries.topic: Where the network splits: H-1B row, Musk v Navarro, Musk–Trump reconciliation

claims.text: AFP 30 Dec 2024: Musk said elite foreign engineering talent was 'essential for America to keep winning', warned of a 'MAGA civil war' and said 'I will go to war on this issue'; Bannon called H-1B migrants essentially 'indentured servants' and Musk a 'toddler'; Loomer: 'inevitable divorce between President Trump and Big Tech'; Trump (28 Dec, to NY Post): 'I've always liked the (H1-B) visas'
ABC 8 Apr 2025: Musk called Navarro 'a moron' and 'dumber than a sack of bricks' over tariffs; Navarro called Musk a 'car assembler'; Leavitt: 'boys will be boys'

Al-Monitor Nov 2025: Musk attended Trump's White House dinner for Mohammed bin Salman on 18 Nov 2025, second joint public appearance since the feud after a handshake at Charlie Kirk's memorial in September; described as a possible sign of reconciliation

sources.label: AFP via Dawn, on the H-1B dispute among Trump's allies, 30 December 2024
